items.name: Glasgow 3x3 Evening 2024

venue.name: Learning and Teaching Building, Strathclyde University

items.information:
## This is a Wednesday evening competition with only 3x3 as an event. It is suitable for all skill levels: first timers, beginners, and advanced cubers alike!

Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

**Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!**
